operational_stops.claim: proposed stop criteria, not real-time or aggregate-RSS guarantees

later_separate_batches: same jobs in one plan vs one job per plan
explicit failure/terminal retry plus exact prelaunch resumption
same active size with 0 vs 2 retained finalized roots, built in place
recorded-child crash/restart and one-artifact corruption in independent fresh stores

larger_tiers.condition: only after previous tier evidence and fresh resource check fit declared budget; no automatic 1000-job run

required_outputs: controller return and durable stage receipts
logical read/hash counters only in separately identified diagnostic run
authenticated child cleanup and exact terminal roster
source_preservation: caller-selected scratch output; never run source-directory-changing run_tests.sh in place; verify frozen pins before/after
integrity: all existing checks enabled, real tiny subprocess histories only, no fabricated terminals, no moved/cloned stores, no source bypass or stale index
execution_gate: independent technical review plus fresh resource boundary under standing authorization; no new user-approval requirement
